```python
def fix_evals(content):
    # Matches eval("content") where content can contain escaped quotes and newlines
    pattern = r'eval\("((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"\);'

    def replace(match):
        code = match.group(1)
        # Unescape common sequences
        code = code.replace('\\n', '\n').replace('\\r', '\r').replace('\\t', '\t')
        code = code.replace('\\"', '"').replace('\\\'', "'")
        code = code.replace('\\\\', '\\')
        # Remove sourceURL comments
        code = re.sub(r'//# sourceURL=.*', '', code)
        return code

    return re.sub(pattern, replace, content)
```
